scope: Every Git blob in both immutable source trees; path moves classified by full byte SHA-256, not filenames or rename heuristics
snapshot_boundary: Separate receipt for concurrent source changes discovered after the frozen catalog. Its object denominator remains unchanged.
limitations: Source-byte preservation does not prove deployed application behavior, authenticated media access, rendering reproducibility, or artistic acceptance.
Existing decode receipts are reused only by exact SHA-256 and byte count; new source code is inventoried without execution.
